data: Which of the following are true regarding the distribution of females and males in the rank of users with most followers?

The intersection point occurs at approximately 14% of the top users sorted by number of followers. From this point onwards, the fraction of females becomes higher than males. Therefore, the statement "The intersection point occurs at approximately 14% of the top users sorted by number of followers" is true. Additionally, the statement "From this point onwards, the fraction of females becomes higher than males" is also true.
